title: 产线分组统计
objective: 按产线分组汇总批次和件数，并按组内批次数筛选。
statement: 按 line_id 分组，统计每条产线的批次数与生产件数合计，只保留批次数不少于 3 的产线，依次输出 line_id、batch_count、total_quantity。三批整也保留；空表不产生分组行。
knowledge: GROUP BY line_id 让每个产线编号对应一个结果组；COUNT(*) 数组内批次，SUM(quantity) 汇总组内件数。
按 line_id 而不是 workshop 分组，结果粒度是产线；若之后连接 workshop，同车间仍可能有多条产线。
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 在分组后按批次数筛组，包含 3 的边界。WHERE 阶段处理原始批次行，不能在其中直接使用聚合 COUNT(*)。空输入没有组，结果为零行。
starterSql: -- 按产线统计，只保留批次数不少于 3 次的产线。

hints.text: 输出粒度是一条产线：先按 line_id 汇总每组，再按组内批次条数保留达标产线。
GROUP BY line_id 建立分组，HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 在聚合后筛组；COUNT(*) 和 SUM(quantity) 分别统计批次和件数。
SELECT line_id, COUNT(*) AS batch_count, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM batches GROUP BY ____ HAVING ____;

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT line_id, COUNT(*) AS batch_count, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM batches GROUP BY line_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;
referenceSolutions.explanation: 每个 line_id 形成一组，在组内计算批次数和件数总和；HAVING 保留达到三批门槛的产线。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT line_id, COUNT(*) AS batch_count, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM batches GROUP BY line_id;
SELECT line_id, COUNT(*) AS batch_count, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM batches GROUP BY line_id HAVING SUM(quantity) >= 1000;
SELECT line_id, COUNT(*) AS batch_count, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM batches GROUP BY line_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
SELECT line_id, COUNT(*) AS batch_count, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM batches GROUP BY line_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
